description: eBPF CUDA/NCCL GPU profiler — runtime API, kernel tracing, multi-GPU communication, memory

panels.title: CUDA Call Rate by Pod & GPU

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (operation, le) (rate(profi_cuda_duration_bucket_total{namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", gpu=~"$gpu"}[$__rate_interval])))
histogram_quantile(0.50, sum by (operation, le) (rate(profi_cuda_duration_bucket_total{namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", gpu=~"$gpu"}[$__rate_interval])))
sum by (pod, gpu, direction) (rate(profi_cuda_memcpy_bytes_total{namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", gpu=~"$gpu"}[$__rate_interval]))
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (operation, le) (rate(profi_nccl_duration_bucket_total{namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", gpu=~"$gpu"}[$__rate_interval])))
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (operation, le) (rate(profi_nccl_duration_bucket_total{namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", gpu=~"$gpu"}[$__rate_interval])))
histogram_quantile(0.50, sum by (operation, le) (rate(profi_nccl_duration_bucket_total{namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", gpu=~"$gpu"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Top Kernels by Launch Rate (full mode)

targets.expr: topk(15, sum by (kernel) (rate(profi_cuda_kernel_launches_total{namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", gpu=~"$gpu", kernel!="anonymous"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Kernel Duration P99 by Class (full mode)

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (kernel_class, le) (rate(profi_cuda_kernel_duration_bucket_total{namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", gpu=~"$gpu"}[$__rate_interval])))

topk(10, sum by (kernel) (rate(profi_cuda_kernel_duration_sum_seconds_total{namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", gpu=~"$gpu"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (kernel) (rate(profi_cuda_kernel_duration_count_total{namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", gpu=~"$gpu"}[$__rate_interval])))
